items.name: kakao-core
items.title: Katok UI Core
items.description: Design tokens (kakao.css, with evidence grades) and the inline icon set every component shares. Installed automatically as a dependency.

items.name: chat-bubble
items.title: Chat Bubble
items.description: KakaoTalk message bubble — yellow outgoing / white incoming, first-bubble tail, unread count "1", timestamp, edited flag.

items.name: message-group
items.title: Message Group
items.description: Consecutive messages from one sender: squircle avatar + name on the first bubble, tail on the first, time on the last.

items.name: profile-avatar
items.title: Profile Avatar
items.description: KakaoTalk squircle profile picture with default silhouette and 2–4 member group-chat composites.

items.name: chat-header
items.title: Chat Header
items.description: Chat room header (back + unread total, title, member count, search, menu) and large-title tab header; optional phone button (`onCall`); `leading` avatar on the large-title tab header; `HeaderIconButton` for custom actions.

items.name: message-input
items.title: Message Input
items.description: Compose bar: attach, auto-growing field, emoji, # search that turns into the yellow send button. IME-safe Enter.

items.name: date-separator
items.title: Date Separator
items.description: Translucent date pill between message days, with a KakaoTalk-format date helper.

items.name: system-message
items.title: System Message
items.description: Centered notice for joins, leaves, invites and deleted messages, with optional action.

items.name: chat-list-item
items.title: Chat List Item
items.description: Chats tab row: squircle or group composite avatar, member count, open chat mark, 2-line preview, time, red unread badge, mute and pin; `selected` turns it into a picker row with a round check.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: Sheet surface (44pt corners, grabber, white or gray tone) with sheet search, centered title, and tile / card rows (파일, 통화하기).

items.name: share-sheet
items.title: Share Sheet
items.description: Bottom sheet for sharing into a chat: grabber, search field, filter chips, picker rows and a quick-share row.

items.name: mention
items.title: Mention
items.description: Blue `@이름` in bubbles and the input (`withMentions()`), and the member list that pops up above the input after "@".

items.name: sticker-message
items.title: Sticker Message
items.description: Emoticon / sticker message: the art alone at ~150pt, no bubble, time beside it.

items.name: media-bubble
items.title: Media Bubble
items.description: Shared photo / video / short-form card: 16pt-radius poster, source and title over a top scrim, play mark, side share button.

items.name: bot-message
items.title: Bot Message
items.description: Chatbot answer clipped with a "전체보기 >" footer, plus the follow-up card with one gray button.

items.name: message-reactions
items.title: Message Reactions
items.description: Reaction chips under a bubble with counts, your own reactions highlighted, and a smiley-plus chip to add more.

items.name: reaction-picker
items.title: Reaction Picker
items.description: Bottom sheet with reaction search and a sectioned 6-column emoji grid.

items.name: attachment-sheet
items.title: Attachment Sheet
items.description: The sheet the input's "+" opens: recent-photo strip with camera tile and 전송, grouped attachment rows with colored icons, promo banner.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message Actions
items.description: Long-press menu: quick-reaction card over 복사 · 답장 · 공유 · … · 삭제 with trailing icons.

items.name: notice-banner
items.title: Notice Banner
items.description: Pinned 공지 card under the chat header: megaphone, one-line notice, "…" for more, close. Slots into `<ChatRoom notice>`.

items.name: voice-recorder
items.title: Voice Recorder
items.description: 음성메시지 sheet body: gray idle bar, yellow level bar and timer while recording, record / stop / send controls.

items.name: capture-mode
items.title: Capture Mode
items.description: 캡처 mode: glass header (닫기, 선택 해제), a spotlight selection that dims the rest of the chat, and a glass toolbar (옵션, 저장, 공유).

items.name: action-sheet
items.title: Action Sheet
items.description: iOS 26 glass action sheet with stacked pill buttons and 취소 (송금하기 · 요청하기 · 1/N 정산하기 …).

items.name: location-picker
items.title: Location Picker
items.description: 지도 → 이 위치 보내기: header, floating search, category chips, locate button and address card over your own map.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: Tab Bar
items.description: Five-tab bar (친구 · 채팅 · 지금 · 쇼핑 · 더보기) with filled glyphs and the red unread badge.

items.name: filter-chips
items.title: Filter Chips
items.description: Pill filters, black when active, with an orange count: chats-tab folders, 친구 / 소식, sheet filters.

items.name: promo-banner
items.title: Promo Banner
items.description: Gray promo card with bold title, gray line and art; 88pt on the tabs, 60pt in sheets.

items.name: friend-list
items.title: Friend List
items.description: Friends-tab parts: section label with count and sort, updated-friends strip (new dot, AD), friend rows with an action or count.

items.name: profile-view
items.title: Profile View
items.description: Full-screen profile: background hero, heart count, avatar, name, glass action bar (나와의 채팅 | 새 게시물), post grid with pin / video marks.

items.name: feed-post
items.title: Feed Post
items.description: A 소식 feed post: author row with time and kind, rounded photo, like and comment.

items.name: call-screen
items.title: Call Screen
items.description: 보이스톡 in progress: dark card with the callee, ringing dots, record pill and tip, control row with the red hang-up.

items.name: call-transcript
items.title: Call Transcript
items.description: A recorded 보이스톡 as chat: gray / yellow lines with offsets, the playing line outlined, AI 통화요약 pill, player with ±5s.

items.name: shortform-view
items.title: Shortform View
items.description: 지금 tab short-form chrome over your clip: heading, segments, right action column with counts, channel row, title, views, progress.

items.name: community-post
items.title: Community Post
items.description: 지금 tab open-chat community post: room, author, topic tag, photo, reaction summary and comments, threaded replies.

items.name: chat-room
items.title: Chat Room
items.description: Layout shell: header, scrollable message log on the chat background, input bar; `notice` slot for a pinned 공지.

items.name: biz-button
items.title: Biz Button
items.description: Kakao Biz Message button using the API button codes (WL, AL, DS, BK, MD, BC, BT, AC, BF, TN, P1–P3).

items.name: alimtalk-bubble
items.title: AlimTalk Bubble
items.description: AlimTalk (알림톡) preview mirroring the API fields — messageType BA/EX/AD/MI, emphasizeType NONE/TEXT/IMAGE/ITEM_LIST, buttons, quick replies, length limits.

items.name: brand-message-bubble
items.title: Brand Message Bubble
items.description: Brand Message (브랜드메시지, FriendTalk successor) preview — TEXT, IMAGE, WIDE, CAROUSEL_FEED, coupons, (광고) prefix and opt-out footer.
